tables.name: tenant
tables.retention: preserve tenant tombstone and references

tables.name: project
tables.retention: preserve while referenced

tables.name: membership

checks.name: ck_membership_scope
checks.expression: (scope_type='TENANT' AND project_id IS NULL) OR (scope_type='PROJECT' AND project_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_membership_project
indexes.purpose: project member list and composite FK

tables.retention: retain revocation history

tables.name: role
tables.retention: preserve referenced roles

tables.name: role_binding

checks.name: ck_role_binding_scope
checks.expression: (scope_type='TENANT' AND scope_id IS NULL) OR (scope_type='PROJECT' AND scope_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: idx_role_binding_role
indexes.purpose: role impact analysis and composite FK

tables.retention: retain revocation history

tables.name: workflow_definition
tables.retention: preserve while versions or instances reference definition

tables.name: workflow_version

partitioning.reason: immutable versions remain bounded per definition

tables.retention: never delete while any instance or compliance rule references version

tables.name: trigger_config

checks.name: ck_trigger_config_cron
checks.expression: (trigger_type = 'cron' AND timezone IS NOT NULL AND btrim(timezone) <> '' AND misfire_policy IN ('skip','fire_once','catch_up_limited')) OR (trigger_type <> 'cron' AND timezone IS NULL AND misfire_policy IS NULL)

indexes.name: idx_trigger_config_version
indexes.purpose: version trigger lookup and composite FK

tables.retention: same as workflow_version

tables.name: connector

checks.name: ck_connector_delete_fields
checks.expression: (deleted_at IS NULL AND deleted_by IS NULL AND deletion_reason IS NULL) OR (deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_by IS NOT NULL AND btrim(deleted_by) <> '' AND deletion_reason IS NOT NULL AND btrim(deletion_reason) <> '')

tables.retention: retain tombstone through reference window

tables.name: secret_reference

checks.name: ck_secret_reference_material
checks.expression: (provider='local' AND ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(ciphertext) > 0 AND external_key IS NULL) OR (provider<>'local' AND external_key IS NOT NULL AND btrim(external_key) <> '' AND ciphertext IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_secret_reference_delete_fields
checks.expression: (deleted_at IS NULL AND deleted_by IS NULL AND deletion_reason IS NULL) OR (deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_by IS NOT NULL AND btrim(deleted_by) <> '' AND deletion_reason IS NOT NULL AND btrim(deletion_reason) <> '')

indexes.name: idx_secret_reference_project
indexes.purpose: authorized secret reference lookup and composite FK

tables.retention: retain encrypted tombstone metadata; purge ciphertext by key policy

tables.name: workflow_instance

checks.name: ck_workflow_instance_state_times
checks.expression: (status = 'CREATED' AND started_at IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSE_REQUESTED','PAUSED','CANCEL_REQUESTED') AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('CANCELLED','SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_workflow_instance_time_order
checks.expression: updated_at >= created_at AND (started_at IS NULL OR started_at >= created_at) AND (completed_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= started_at)

checks.name: ck_workflow_instance_optional_text
checks.expression: (business_key IS NULL OR btrim(business_key) <> '') AND (input_ref IS NULL OR btrim(input_ref) <> '')

indexes.name: idx_workflow_instance_version
indexes.purpose: definition-consistent version history and composite FK

partitioning.activateWhen: measured history volume requires partition pruning; validate FK/unique redesign first

tables.retention: hot query window then archive/purge by tenant policy

tables.name: node_instance

checks.name: ck_node_instance_counters
checks.expression: attempt_no >= 0 AND dispatch_count >= 0 AND lease_generation >= 0 AND version >= 0

checks.name: ck_node_instance_schedule
checks.expression: (status IN ('READY','RETRY_WAIT','WAITING_TIMER') AND next_schedule_at IS NOT NULL AND next_schedule_at >= updated_at) OR (status NOT IN ('READY','RETRY_WAIT','WAITING_TIMER') AND next_schedule_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_node_instance_lease
checks.expression: (status IN ('DISPATCHED','RUNNING') AND current_worker_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(current_worker_id) <> '' AND lease_expire_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expire_at > updated_at) OR (status NOT IN ('DISPATCHED','RUNNING') AND current_worker_id IS NULL AND lease_expire_at IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_node_instance_output
checks.expression: (output_ref IS NULL AND output_digest IS NULL) OR (output_ref IS NOT NULL AND btrim(output_ref) <> '' AND output_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

checks.name: ck_node_instance_error
checks.expression: (status IN ('FAILED','RETRY_WAIT') AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND btrim(error_code) <> '') OR (status NOT IN ('FAILED','RETRY_WAIT') AND error_code IS NULL)

rls.policy: tenant_id = app_tenant_id(); worker uses constrained service policy

partitioning.reason: keep FK and scheduler indexes simple; archive with parent instance

tables.retention: same lifecycle as workflow_instance

tables.name: task_execution

checks.name: ck_task_execution_state_fields
checks.expression: (status = 'RUNNING' AND finished_at IS NULL AND output_ref IS NULL AND output_digest IS NULL AND error_code IS NULL AND error_summary_redacted IS NULL) OR (status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NULL AND error_summary_redacted IS NULL) OR (status IN ('FAILED','TIMED_OUT','ABANDONED','CANCELLED') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND error_code IS NOT NULL AND btrim(error_code) <> '' AND error_summary_redacted IS NOT NULL AND btrim(error_summary_redacted) <> '')

checks.name: ck_task_execution_time_order
checks.expression: updated_at >= created_at AND started_at >= created_at AND (finished_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= started_at)

checks.name: ck_task_execution_input
checks.expression: input_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (input_ref IS NULL OR btrim(input_ref) <> '')

checks.name: ck_task_execution_output
checks.expression: (output_ref IS NULL AND output_digest IS NULL) OR (output_ref IS NOT NULL AND btrim(output_ref) <> '' AND output_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

rls.policy: tenant_id = app_tenant_id(); worker uses constrained service policy

partitioning.activateWhen: measured attempt volume justifies partitioning; terminal rows become append-only

tables.retention: partition archive after instance retention and replay window

tables.name: schedule_occurrence

checks.name: ck_schedule_occurrence_state_fields
checks.expression: (status = 'PENDING' AND claimed_at IS NULL AND workflow_instance_id IS NULL) OR (status = 'CLAIMED' AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND workflow_instance_id IS NULL) OR (status = 'FIRED' AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND workflow_instance_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status IN ('SKIPPED','FAILED') AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL AND workflow_instance_id IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_schedule_occurrence_claim_time
checks.expression: claimed_at IS NULL OR claimed_at >= scheduled_at

indexes.name: idx_schedule_occurrence_trigger
indexes.purpose: Cron snapshot history and composite FK

rls.policy: tenant_id = app_tenant_id(); scheduler uses constrained service policy

partitioning.activateWhen: Cron occurrence history crosses measured threshold

tables.retention: retain past maximum catch-up/recovery window, then archive/purge

tables.name: outbox_event

checks.name: ck_outbox_event_lease
checks.expression: (published_at IS NULL AND ((publisher_id IS NULL AND publish_lease_until IS NULL) OR (publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(publisher_id) <> '' AND publish_lease_until IS NOT NULL AND publish_lease_until > created_at))) OR (published_at IS NOT NULL AND publisher_id IS NULL AND publish_lease_until IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_outbox_event_times
checks.expression: next_publish_at >= occurred_at AND (published_at IS NULL OR published_at >= occurred_at)

indexes.name: idx_outbox_event_publish_lease
indexes.predicate: published_at IS NULL AND publisher_id IS NOT NULL

rls.policy: tenant_id = app_tenant_id(); publisher uses constrained service policy

partitioning.activateWhen: published history exceeds replay and diagnostics window

tables.retention: keep past maximum consumer replay window before archive/purge

tables.name: processed_event

uniqueConstraints.name: uq_processed_event_consumer_event
uniqueConstraints.globalScopeReason: event_id is globally unique and consumer deduplication is independent of tenant routing

rls.policy: tenant_id = app_tenant_id(); consumers use constrained service policy

tables.retention: longer than Kafka/event replay window

tables.name: idempotency_record

checks.name: ck_idempotency_record_response
checks.expression: (status = 'PROCESSING' AND response_status IS NULL AND response_ref IS NULL AND response_digest IS NULL) OR (status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED') AND response_status BETWEEN 100 AND 599 AND response_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (response_ref IS NULL OR btrim(response_ref) <> ''))

checks.name: ck_idempotency_record_time
checks.expression: updated_at >= created_at AND expires_at > created_at AND version >= 0

tables.retention: not shorter than maximum client retry window

tables.name: dead_letter

checks.name: ck_dead_letter_payload
checks.expression: (payload_ref IS NULL AND payload_digest IS NULL) OR (payload_ref IS NOT NULL AND btrim(payload_ref) <> '' AND payload_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

checks.name: ck_dead_letter_disposition
checks.expression: (status = 'OPEN' AND disposition_count = 0 AND last_disposition_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('REQUEUED','RESOLVED','DISMISSED') AND disposition_count > 0 AND last_disposition_at IS NOT NULL AND last_disposition_at >= created_at)

partitioning.reason: open operational set must remain simple

tables.retention: keep resolution metadata; purge sensitive payload after shorter policy

tables.name: worker_lease

checks.name: ck_worker_lease_times
checks.expression: updated_at >= created_at AND acquired_at >= created_at AND expires_at > acquired_at AND (status <> 'ACTIVE' OR expires_at > updated_at) AND (last_heartbeat_at IS NULL OR (last_heartbeat_at >= acquired_at AND last_heartbeat_at <= expires_at)) AND (released_at IS NULL OR released_at >= acquired_at)

checks.name: ck_worker_lease_lifecycle
checks.expression: (status = 'ACTIVE' AND released_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('RELEASED','EXPIRED','FENCED') AND released_at IS NOT NULL)

rls.policy: tenant_id = app_tenant_id(); worker uses constrained service policy

tables.retention: keep beyond maximum late-result and incident window

tables.name: human_task

checks.name: ck_human_task_candidate
checks.expression: (candidate_role_code IS NULL OR candidate_role_code ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$') AND (assignee_subject IS NULL OR btrim(assignee_subject) <> '') AND (candidate_role_code IS NOT NULL OR assignee_subject IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_human_task_form
checks.expression: jsonb_typeof(form_schema) = 'object' AND form_schema <> '{}'::jsonb AND ((form_data_ref IS NULL AND form_data_digest IS NULL) OR (form_data_ref IS NOT NULL AND btrim(form_data_ref) <> '' AND form_data_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'))

checks.name: ck_human_task_decision
checks.expression: (status = 'DECIDED' AND decision IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND decision_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_by IS NOT NULL AND btrim(decided_by) <> '') OR (status IN ('WAITING','TIMED_OUT','CANCELLED') AND decision IS NULL AND decision_at IS NULL AND decided_by IS NULL)

checks.name: ck_human_task_timeout
checks.expression: (deadline_at IS NULL AND timeout_policy = 'NONE' AND status <> 'TIMED_OUT') OR (deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND deadline_at >= created_at AND timeout_policy IN ('FAIL','AUTO_APPROVE','AUTO_REJECT','ESCALATE'))

checks.name: ck_human_task_transfer
checks.expression: (transfer_count = 0 AND last_transferred_at IS NULL AND last_transferred_by IS NULL) OR (transfer_count > 0 AND last_transferred_at IS NOT NULL AND last_transferred_at >= created_at AND last_transferred_by IS NOT NULL AND btrim(last_transferred_by) <> '')

checks.name: ck_human_task_audit
checks.expression: updated_at >= created_at AND version >= transfer_count AND (decision_at IS NULL OR (decision_at >= created_at AND decision_at <= updated_at)) AND (last_transferred_at IS NULL OR last_transferred_at <= updated_at)

indexes.name: idx_human_task_assignee
indexes.predicate: status='WAITING' AND assignee_subject IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: idx_human_task_candidate
indexes.predicate: status='WAITING' AND candidate_role_code IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: idx_human_task_deadline
indexes.predicate: status='WAITING' AND deadline_at IS NOT NULL

partitioning.reason: active inbox indexes remain simple; archive with instance

tables.retention: same as workflow instance; decision evidence remains in audit

tables.name: audit_log

checks.name: ck_audit_log_actor
checks.expression: actor_type IN ('USER','SERVICE','WORKER','SYSTEM','PLATFORM_ADMIN') AND btrim(actor_id) <> '' AND (tenant_id IS NOT NULL OR actor_type = 'PLATFORM_ADMIN')

checks.name: ck_audit_log_payload
checks.expression: (reason IS NULL OR btrim(reason) <> '') AND (before_digest_or_redacted IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(before_digest_or_redacted) = 'object') AND (after_digest_or_redacted IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(after_digest_or_redacted) = 'object')

indexes.name: idx_audit_log_tenant_time
indexes.purpose: tenant audit cursor and tenant FK

rls.policy: tenant_id = app_tenant_id() OR (tenant_id IS NULL AND app_is_platform_admin())

partitioning.activateWhen: audit volume requires pruning; append-only trigger remains per partition

tables.retention: tenant/compliance-specific; never ordinary soft delete

tables.name: quota_usage

indexes.name: idx_quota_usage_active
indexes.purpose: current quota lookup and tenant FK

tables.retention: retain billing/audit window, then aggregate and purge
